heroMeta: Elo simulation + Bayesian updates, never reading a market price · forecast date
subGroups: All 72 group-stage matches, with win / draw / loss probabilities. Open any match for the reasons.
subKnockout: The full path from group qualification to the final.
subPerformance: Graded after the fact: our market-blind forecasts vs the market price at forecast time.
ruleNote: Format: the top two in every group advance to the round of 32, joined by the 8 best third-placed teams across the 12 groups — so each group sends 2 or 3 teams through.
marginalTitle: Each team's odds to reach each round
cloudNote: Bigger flag = higher title odds · click for the reasoning
sampleHint: Pick a real question to see the agent's actual output
formulaLegend: ν = 0.7 (draw parameter) · R is the live Elo rating · Δ is the evidence-driven bounded shift (|Δ| ≤ 8pp per match, renormalized)
wbSoon: The full workbench is coming soon — try the sample run below.
reportFallback: Full report available in English below; card content is localized.
perfRule: When we bet: skip if our number is close to the market, bet only when the gap is wide.
perfRuleTerms: back = bet it happens · fade = bet it won't · a win pays the market's odds, a loss is −100%.
perfLegendNote: Top = ours, bottom = the market at forecast time; bold = actual result. Win / draw / loss are bet independently.
perfCalibNote: We split every forecast into 10 buckets by probability. In each bucket, the average probability we quoted (predicted) should land close to how often it actually happened (observed) — the closer the two, the more trustworthy the numbers.
perfDisclaimer: Small, high-variance sample — a single match can swing the P&L. Returns are percentages, not money.
peSub: The same pipeline behind every public forecast, yours to run: an Elo prior, Monte-Carlo simulations, and Bayesian updates — never a market price.
betaDesc: Enter the beta password to open the Forecasting Engine console.
peStep1Copy: Any match, group winner, or title odds. Just ask.
peStep2Copy: Public data gathered by priority: recent results, club form, injuries and lineups, venue and weather. Every fact dated and sourced; odds pages discarded.
peStep3Copy: Live Elo gives win / draw / loss per match; qualification and title questions run 100,000 Monte-Carlo simulations.
peStep4Copy: Key evidence becomes a bounded shift on the prior — at most ±8 points per match, nothing moves without evidence. Every output carries a confidence tier.
peStep5Copy: Multilingual reports with full sources; every question Brier-scored in public after settlement — wrong calls stay on record.
